text:
Nora: Tiny idea 1 1 1 let's do a 'gratitude jar' and a postcard wall in the common area for the holidays?
Priya: Love that. People can drop short notes or funny mini-postcards, stick them on the wall. Low effort, high cheer.
Mateo: I'm in. I'll raid my stash of colored Post-its.
Ethan: Would be cool if remote folks could submit digital postcards and we print them weekly.
Zara: Great call. I'll set up a shared doc where remote folks can paste 1-liners and we can print on cardstock.
Facilities: Heads up 1 we have a 3m cork roll left in the supply room if you want to pin postcards. Message us when you want us to hang it.
Nora: @Facilities can you hang it on Tuesday morning? We'll do a quick volunteer shift to organize by theme.
Priya: Themes? Thoughts: thankfulness, goofy memories, new-year hopes, and tiny drawings.
Mateo: Also a 'non-holiday' lane for people who prefer neutral notes.
Ethan: Nice. Quick poll 1 react with :heart: for physical postcard only, :computer: for remote/digital contribution, :white_check_mark: for either.
Zara: I'll add a short blurb for the company newsletter so folks know how to contribute.
Priya: Can we add a small prize for the most delightful postcard? Maybe Facilities swag or a free lunch coupon?
Facilities: We can donate a few snack cards. No single-use plastic wrapped candy though, please.
DevBot: Reminder set for Tuesday 09:00 to hang the cork roll.
Nora: Also, happy-holiday style signage should be subtle. Keep it inclusive 1 "Seasonal cheer & thanks wall" ok?
Ethan: Love that wording. Also adding a small table with pens, tape, and blank cards for spontaneous notes.
Mateo: I'll be the first to leave an absurd doodle postcard. Warning: my stick-figure reindeer is very abstract.
Zara: Remote folks 1 drop contributions into this doc: https://docs.example.com/gratitude-wall (pls paste a one-liner or image).
Priya: Quick logistics: who can help print A6 cards Wednesday afternoon? I can do 10 mins at 3pm.
Nora: I can help print at 3:10.
Facilities: We'll put out a small bin labeled 'for printing' by the copier.
Ethan: Also, if anyone wants to write a short holiday greeting to the ops team, they did great this year.
Mateo: Agreed, shoutout to Facilities and Eng-oncall.
Zara: Adding a short caption template for remote folks so prints look consistent.
Nora: Thanks everyone 1 excited to see the wall and the tiny creative chaos. :sparkles:
